title: 2 Chronicles 22
paragraphs: ¹ The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, his youngest son, king in his place, for the raiding party that came with the Arabians to the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah. ² Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri. ³ He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in doing wickedly. ⁴ He did evil in the eyes of the LORD like the house of Ahab had done, for after his father's death they became his advisors, to his ruin. ⁵ Following their counsel, he went with Jehoram son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram.

⁶ He returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. And Azariah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab, because he was ill. ⁷ It was God's will that Ahaziah's downfall would come through his visit to Joram. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Jehoram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab. ⁸ While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's relatives who had been serving Ahaziah, and he killed them. ⁹ He then went in search of Ahaziah, who was caught hiding in Samaria, brought to Jehu, and put to death. They buried him — "because," they said, "he was a grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart." The house of Ahaziah had no one strong enough to hold the kingdom. ¹⁰ When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the entire royal family of the house of Judah.

¹¹ But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be killed. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, daughter of King Jehoram and wife of Jehoiada the priest — because she was a sister of Ahaziah — hid the child from Athaliah so that she did not kill him. ¹² He remained hidden with them in the house of God for six years while Athaliah ruled over the land.
